name: handmux
description: A mobile vibe-coding cockpit — built on tmux: drive your live session, Claude Code / Codex — anything a terminal can run — from your phone.
author: yuanyuanzijin

scripts.start: npm run build:server && node dist/bin/handmux.js start
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && node dist/bin/handmux.js start --foreground
scripts.prepack: npm run bundle && npm run build:server
scripts.test:workspace-host: npm run build:server && HANDMUX_WORKSPACE_HOST=1 vitest run test/workspaceHost.test.js
scripts.test:workspace-docker: npm run build:server && HANDMUX_WORKSPACE_DOCKER=1 vitest run test/workspaceDocker.test.js
